description: Weekly AI-drafted narrative for the /week-ahead view. Written by .claude/commands/week-ahead.md via scripts/apply-week-ahead.mjs. Sunday 22:00 UTC cadence (before US Monday open). Rendered as a panel above the macro strip on /week-ahead. Structured JSON (not markdown) so UI can render sections cleanly.

eventsCount.description: Total earnings events across the covered universe scheduled Mon-Fri.

sections.description: Ordered narrative sections. Typical layout: (1) The setup — macro/market context, (2) What to watch — 3-5 specific events with tickers, (3) Signals to trust — which ranking components are strongest this week.

body.description: 3-5 sentences of narrative prose. NO forward-looking speculation. NO target prices. Every claim must be defensible from data on disk (macro-signals + ranking + events-index).

highlights.description: Specific tickers reporting this week that the AI thinks warrant attention. Each references an existing entry in events-index.json.

note.description: One-line reason this event matters. Cite a real number when possible (composite score, last surprise, macro overlap).

disclaimer.description: Mandatory user-visible disclaimer. Rendered under the narrative panel. Default: 'AI-drafted week-ahead — not advice, not a recommendation. Data grounded in on-disk snapshots; cross-check every claim.'
